data.exact_reserve_text: Movement in 2015 of GBP (3.2)m comprising claims charges of GBP (3.4)m, GBP (0.2)m of additional reinsurance accruals, GBP 0.2m of expense adjustments and investment income of GBP 0.2m. Of the adverse claims movement of GBP 3.4m in the year ended 31 December 2015, GBP 0.4m related to the older years 2006-2010 which appear to have achieved a degree of stability, GBP 2.2m to the 2011 year of account and GBP 0.8m to the pure year of account.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Adverse claims movement related to older years resulting in a strengthening of reserves for the 2006-2010 block.

prior_year_events.event_name: Adverse development on 2011 year of account
prior_year_events.impact_description: Adverse claims development on the 2011 year of account prompting reserve strengthening.
Adverse movement on the pure 2012 year of account contributing to overall adverse claims movement.

named_events.loss_description: One of two main CAT events in 2015; the two main CAT events gave rise to a gross loss of GBP 4.8m and net loss of GBP 1.8m; the largest was Storm Desmond in December 2015.

data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2015 gross claims outstanding were GBP 32.218m. During 2015 the syndicate recorded overall adverse prior-year reserve development of approximately GBP 6.295m (strengthening). The deterioration was driven principally by adverse development in the liability (casualty) book and recalibration of IBNR/reserving assumptions on older years (notably the 2011 and 2012 years and the 2006-2010 block). In addition, significant CAT activity in 2015 (including Storm Desmond) contributed to property losses, though the primary driver of prior-year strengthening was adverse development in older liability years.
raw_causal_phrases: the drift in the 2011 and 2012 years of account
the liability class of business, which has been the class showing the most volatility
significant property losses which have stemmed from a number of CAT events in Australia and the UK, the largest of which was Storm Desmond in December 2015

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (claims cumulative estimates) in the Technical Reserves note (converted from GBP '000 to millions). The report does not present a single labelled 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' gross-amount that sums to a single figure; the P&L 'claims incurred in prior underwriting years' lines were intentionally not used per instructions. The triangle contains an aggregate '2010 & prior' column which was excluded from the diagonal comparison per rules. Some narrative figures (claims charges, components by year of account, and reinsurance accruals) reference related movements and reconcile to portions of the triangle but are P&L or net measures; where explicit gross prior-year movements by year were quoted those have been recorded in prior_year_events. Amounts for LOB movements other than Casualty are not explicitly quantified in the report and are inferred (low confidence).
